$description: Measured from the outlined wordmark. Everything a layout needs in order to place the mark correctly without guessing. Regenerate with brand/tools/outline-wordmark.mjs.

clearSpace.$description: Minimum exclusion zone on all four sides, expressed in the wordmark's own units and as a multiple of its height. Nothing — text, image, rule, or edge of the medium — enters this zone.

minSize.$description: Below these the descender on 'p' and the counters in 'e' close up and the mark stops reading as a word.
